name: Michaels Teacher Discount
description: 15% off entire purchase for verified educators
fullDescription: Michaels offers verified teachers and educators 15% off their entire purchase, including sale items, through the free Michaels Rewards program.
whatTheyOffer:
- 15% off entire purchase, including sale items
- Every day, online and in store
- Free Michaels Rewards membership
- Limit one teacher discount per day
- Exclusions include clearance, custom framing, gift cards, classes, craft machines (such as Cricut), and select brands
howToGetIt:
1. Log in or create a free Michaels Rewards account
2. Complete educator verification (instant for most people)
3. Online: Sign in to your account at checkout
4. In store: Give your Michaels Rewards phone number at checkout; you may be asked for a valid educator ID
keywords: Michaels, teacher discount, educator, 15% off, craft supplies, classroom, art supplies
